title: Two-Minute Mayonnaise
description: Fast immersion-blender mayonnaise made with egg yolk, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and neutral oil.
steps: Place the egg yolk, water, lemon juice, and mustard in the bottom of an immersion-blender cup.
Pour the oil on top and let it settle for 15 seconds.
Place the immersion-blender head at the bottom of the cup and switch it on. As the mayonnaise forms, slowly tilt and lift the blender until all of the oil is emulsified.
Season to taste with salt. Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.
notes: Source: Serious Eats. Volume and count measurements were converted to approximate gram weights.
